vibe_rationale: Counterculture institution since 1976 with a maker-only rule and community ownership, authentic and curated by ethos but narrow and not set up for brands.
fit_notes: Deep alternative hinterland community of adults, but the maker-only rule likely shuts out branded stalls, so reach for a brand is hard. Any role would be community support rather than presence; it is an NSW market, so direct contact is possible.
